title: Staff summit facilitator brief and spike plan
content:
Purpose and context:
This doc is a lightweight facilitator brief + planning spike for the staff summit (company-week) that will double as the Q2 all-hands + executive update. Goal is to outline the run of show, draft OKR framing for the exec update slot, propose interactive facilitation patterns that scale to 150 people, and enumerate follow-ups and measurement.

Audience:
- Company staff (all teams)
- Execs (Founders, CEO update, CS/Eng/Product leads)
- People Ops & Communications (logistics + comms)

High-level goals for the session (what success looks like):
- Clear rallying north-star for next 90 days: 3 focused company priorities (communicable in one line each).
- Exec update communicates tradeoffs, resource asks, and 2 measurable signals we will watch.
- Teams leave with 1 committed team-level OKR and 1 cross-team dependency flagged.
- Sentiment: >70% of attendees say they felt informed and clear on immediate next steps (post-event pulse).

Constraints and assumptions:
- 150 total attendees, hybrid (120 in-person, ~30 remote). AV is booked, but latency may affect breakouts.
- Slot timeframes: total 2.5 hours including break. Exec update 25m, Q&A 15m, breakout 40m, synthesis + close 20m.
- We’ll record the session; however remote participation must be actively included.

Run of show (detailed)
1) 0:00 – 0:10 — Welcome + orientation (CEO / emcee)
   - Quick icebreakers: one-word pulse typed into chat (remote) / colored sticker (in-person)
   - Frame the constraints, cadence, and what we expect people to commit to after.
2) 0:10 – 0:35 — Exec Update: Where we are, why it matters (CEO + VP Eng + VP Product)
   - 10m CEO: macro thesis, market signal, ask to staff
   - 10m VP Eng: reliability & capacity posture, Dedicated/Private highlights
   - 5m VP Product: focused product bets and experimental metrics
3) 0:35 – 0:50 — Rapid Q&A (live crowd + Slido)
   - Pre-filtered 6 questions + 4 live from Slido (manage time tightly)
4) 0:50 – 1:30 — Breakout working session (team-led + cross-functional tables)
   - Prompt #1 (20m): Draft one team-level OKR that directly supports a company priority; identify 1 dependency and 1 risk mitigation.
   - Prompt #2 (20m): Cross-team table pickup: surface required cross-team coordination or runway requests. Each table captures 3 bullets on shared doc.
   - Logistics: each table has a facilitator; remote join links pre-assigned.
5) 1:30 – 1:45 — Break (15m)
6) 1:45 – 2:05 — Synthesis + prioritization (emcee + live board)
   - Rapid readout: 6 tables x 2 minutes max
   - Live clustering on Miro/board into 3 priority themes; each theme gets 1 owner assigned in the room.
7) 2:05 – 2:20 — Commitment and operational asks (People Ops & Eng Ops)
   - How teams signal readiness, how to request Dedicated/Private capacity, and an ask calendar.
8) 2:20 – 2:30 — Close (CEO) and 2-minute feedback pulse launch

Draft company priorities to test in exec update (one-liners):
- Priority A: "Make inference predictable at scale: reduce tail latency and cost per token for customer workloads by 20%"
- Priority B: "Enterprise footprint: ship VPC-onboarding and 2 compliance integrations for three pilot customers"
- Priority C: "Developer velocity: reduce time-to-first-API-call for PLG signups to <5 minutes"

OKR framing for exec update (slides plan)
- For each priority show:
  - 1 line problem statement (why now)
  - 2 lead metrics (health & velocity), baseline + target for 90 days
  - 1 major constraint (capacity, hiring, partner integration)
  - 1 explicit ask of staff (e.g., focus areas, shadow teams, experimental rigor)

Example candidate metrics (useful for slides):
- Median p95 inference latency for hosted small models (ms) — baseline 180ms -> target 145ms
- Cost per 1k tokens served for typical PLG route — baseline $0.12 -> target $0.096
- Time-to-first-API-call for new signups — baseline 12m -> target 5m
- Number of enterprise pilots onboarded with compliance package — baseline 0 -> target 2

Breakout facilitation notes (operational):
- Table facilitators: assign 12 people (mix of PMs, eng leads, solutions eng). Script for facilitators in a 1-pager: timekeeping, how to capture dependencies, triage red flags.
- Remote rooms: designate 1 facilitator per remote group, ensure AV mic check in first 5 mins.
- Template doc: simple table with columns: team, proposed OKR, dependency, blocker, owner, timeline. Link in Slack #staff-summit.

Pulse and measurement (post-event)
- 24-48h pulse survey: 6 quick questions (inform, clear, next steps, actions I will take, blockers I anticipate, open feedback). Target response rate 55%+ within 48h.
- Ops: synth doc to be published to Confluence within 72h with consolidated OKRs and assigned owners.
- Action tracker: JIRA board created; each table’s top dependency -> issue with tag SUMMIT-2025 and an owner assigned within 3 business days.

Open questions / decisions needed (ask list for execs)
- Which 3 company priorities do we lock during the exec prep meeting? (decision owners: CEO + SLT)
- Are we committing to a public-facing FAQ/commitment doc post-summit? (People Ops + Comms)
- Budget ask: do we allocate a 2-week dev spike fund (unallocated buffer) for cross-team unblock? If yes, how much? (Finance)
- Dedicated infra gating: what is the policy to prioritize Dedicated slots for enterprise pilots vs internal experimentation? (Platform + Sales)

Risks & mitigation
- Risk: breakout outputs are too many and unfocused -> Mitigation: force 1 OKR per team, cap writeups to 100 words, table facilitator triage.
- Risk: remote attendees feel peripheral -> Mitigation: pre-assign remote facilitators and require remote readout slots.
- Risk: exec update raises expectations we can’t meet -> Mitigation: explicit statement of tradeoffs and 2 signal metrics we’ll publish weekly.

Immediate next steps (owners and dates)
- By 2025-02-21: Lock exec update script and slides (Owner: Riley Nguyen).
- By 2025-02-24: Identify and brief 12 table facilitators + facilitator 1-pager (Owner: Ava Martinez).
- By 2025-02-26: Publish pre-read (one pager) to Confluence and Slack, include 3 candidate priorities and pulse link (Owner: Communications).
- By 2025-03-04: Post-summit synth doc + JIRA board created (Owner: People Ops).

Notes-to-self / facilitation tips (short)
- Keep exec slides tight: 3 slides per priority max.
- Use live clustering (Miro) rather than freeform doc; keep in-person visual focal point.
- Prepare 6 fallback Q&A answers for expected hard questions (capacity, pricing, uptime, docs).

Appendix: suggested exec talking points (bullet for speakers)
- CEO: market signal -> why now -> 3 priorities -> ask (where we need staff energy).
- VP Eng: what we’ve improved in platform performance + where we still see tail risk -> 1 example customer story.
- VP Product: how product bets feed into dev funnel and enterprise path; demo snippet of the onboarding flow (30s).

Slack channels to use: #staff-summit (real-time), #ops-announce (pre/post notices), #dedicated-capacity (technical asks).

If helpful I can prep: facilitator 1-pager, table templates (Google doc), a 3-slide exec summary draft, and a candidate pulse survey. Mark which you want me to own and I’ll slot it into the timeline.

Unresolved: exact budget ask for the dev spike (Finance sync scheduled 2025-02-20).

End of brief.
